title: Introduce unified credential lease protocol and sidestream helpers across SDKs
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a unified credential lease protocol across Python/TS/Go SDKs; introduces sidestream helper APIs for lower-latency streaming reconnection; bumps SDK minor versions (py v1.12.0, ts v1.8.3, go v1.5.0).
body:
Summary: This PR adds a cross-language credential lease protocol (lease/renew/revoke cycle) and a set of 'sidestream' helper primitives that let streaming consumers rehearse reconnections with minimal auth friction. Motivation: customers have reported tail latency during credential refresh in hot streaming paths; teams repeatedly implemented ad-hoc lease/heartbeat logic in each SDK. The unified protocol centralizes semantics, reduces duplication, and provides ergonomics for typical streaming patterns (pause/resume, checkpointed reconnect, graceful token handoff).

What changed (high level):
- Core: new lightweight LeaseManager interface and wire-compatible lease token envelope used by py/ts/go SDKs. Lease semantics: TTL, renew window, optional heartbeat, deterministic revocation reason codes.
- Sidestream helpers: small, language-idiomatic helpers that wrap a StreamConnection and LeaseManager to provide pre-warmed reconnection attempts (fast path) and safe fallback (slow path).
- SDK changes: Python (sync + async) added LeaseManager and StreamingSidestream class; TypeScript added SidestreamConnector and minor ergonomic renames for stream iterator helpers; Go added leasefacade and SidestreamDialer with context-aware cancellation.
- Version bumps: py v1.12.0, ts v1.8.3, go v1.5.0. CHANGELOGs updated.

Files touched (representative):
- sdk/python/redwood/lease.py (new)
- sdk/python/redwood/streaming/sidestream.py (new)
- sdk/typescript/src/credentials/lease.ts (new)
- sdk/typescript/src/stream/sidestream-connector.ts (new)
- sdk/go/lease/lease.go (new)
- sdk/go/stream/sidestream_dialer.go (new)
- sdk/*/CHANGELOG.md (updates across 3 SDKs)
- examples/sidestream/ (new samples for py/ts/go)

Small illustrative snippets (kept short):
Python (async):
```python
async with SidestreamConnector(stream_factory, lease_manager) as conn:
    async for chunk in conn.stream():
        process(chunk)
```
TypeScript:
```ts
const connector = new SidestreamConnector(factory, lease);
for await (const evt of connector.stream()) {
  handle(evt);
}
```
Go (conceptual):
```go
dialer := sidestream.NewDialer(factory, lease)
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream := dialer.Dial(ctx)
```

Commits: (summary)
- feat: add lease protocol and envelope (py/ts/go) (3 commits)
- feat: sidestream helper primitives and examples (3 commits)
- docs: changelogs and examples (2 commits)
- tests: add unit + integration tests for renew/failover semantics (4 commits)
- ci: matrix updates to run sidestream e2e across py/ts/go runners (2 commits)

Testing and CI: Added unit tests for lease TTL, renew window jitter, and revocation reasons. Integration e2e runs in CI spin up ephemeral local auth proxy and validates fast reconnect path under token rotation. CI matrix initially flaked on the Windows Go runner due to test timing; I tuned the timeouts and re-ran. Final CI: all checks passed (lint, unit, e2e matrix).

Review conversation (high level):
- Alan Kim (reviewer): "Great consolidation. A couple of ergonomics nits: rename 'renew_window' -> 'renew_before' for clarity; decouple heartbeat option from LeaseManager so consumers can opt out. Also add a quick example showing pause/resume where the sidestream pre-warms a connection while the old one drains."
- Priya (author): "Addressed: renamed field and added opt-out flag. Added pause/resume example and unit test (sidestream_prewarm_test)."
- Marisa Gomez (reviewer): "TS typing looks good, but please add a small note in the TS README about async iterator cancellation semantics so users don't leak timers."
- Priya: "Added README blurb and adjusted connector.close() to clear timers on cancel."
- Oleg Petrov (security review): "Surface token revocation reasons in telemetry and ensure no long-lived goroutines on revoke path."
- Priya: "Added telemetry tags and fixed goroutine leak in Go dialer by adding close channels and a small state machine test."

Follow-ups captured in Linear:
- ENG-3421: polish sidestream telemetry to include lease_reason codes.
- ENG-3499: implement server-side lease demo for Dedicated customers (backlog).

Release notes: "Adds unified credential lease protocol and sidestream helpers for streaming SDKs (Python v1.12.0, TypeScript v1.8.3, Go v1.5.0). Improves streaming reconnection latency during credential rotation and provides example patterns for pause/resume with pre-warmed reconnection."

Backward compatibility: Designed to be additive. Existing SDK consumers who don't opt into LeaseManager or SidestreamConnector see no behavior change. The changes are non-breaking for typical call sites; migration guides added to CHANGELOGs.

Performance: Microbenchmarks show ~40-60ms median improvement on reconnect latency in our hermetic e2e tests when sidestream fast path is used under hot token rotation scenarios.

Merge: squashed and merged to main on 2026-03-03 by Priya Nair. Merge method: squash. CI green at merge time. Tags: py/v1.12.0, ts/v1.8.3, go/v1.5.0 created post-merge.

Notes for maintainers: watch for additional e2e runs against Dedicated infra; ENG-3421 will be used to track telemetry polish. If any downstream SDK consumers report unexpected auth errors during rotation, ask for the 'lease_reason' tag from logs and file a quick follow-up.
